title: Round-trip F# union values with built-in JSON support
goal: Use built-in reflection-based System.Text.Json serialization when F# union cases and payload values must round-trip in an untrimmed JIT application.

selectionNotes: Use built-in reflection-based System.Text.Json serialization when F# union cases and payload values must round-trip in an untrimmed JIT application.
Reflection-only; no source generation, trimming or Native AOT.

packageAssets: FSharp.Core lib/net10.0/FSharp.Core.dll selected for net11.0; see evidence for the exact verified package
System.Text.Json 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 from Microsoft.NETCore.App; framework asset, no separate package
prerequisites: Create an F# executable project targeting net11.0; set LangVersion to 11.0 and reference FSharp.Core 11.
Add `open System.Text.Json` before the definitions in both versions.

constraints: Built-in F# union support is reflection-only: no source generation, trimming or Native AOT support.
Do not add JsonUnionAttribute to this F# model or infer F# support from C# union generator results.
Case and field names form part of the default wire contract. Renaming them can break persisted messages. These checks cover public class union cases, not every supported union shape.
